remarks: Come check out this desirable 1 bedroom apartment in Coach Run. This unit is updated with brand new carpets, freshly painted, an updated bathroom. No one above you, private entry into unit, reserved parking space, spacious rooms, functional layout. Extra storage room in the basement. Central to everything in Norwalk.
